assignment: Two fresh isolated reviewer contexts per condition, six visible case packets each, alternating neutral case IDs. Same grouping and tool permissions across conditions.
grading: Freeze raw responses before revealing oracle. Match concrete causal findings to oracle, independently assess extras, deduplicate by cause. Score each condition separately. Never change the primary oracle to reward responses.
scope_limits: Shared filesystem procedural separation, not sealed security
No latency/token-cost or population-wide performance claim
Package and local emitted prompts, not native external-host installation
mutation_boundary: Reviewers can read assigned visible packets, frozen assigned instructions, and execute safe local tests; outputs only in assigned study result files. No product edits, oracle access, other responses, network or external writes.
repair_policy: If primary bar fails, retain failed raw trial and score; repair from diagnosis only as explicitly labeled development; require a fresh independent evaluation set or label reused cases as post-hoc, not held-out evidence.
